command: node --test (290 tests pass with AWR_TAKEOVER_BIN set to an awr built from the changed originoneai/awr code); twenty-three mutations of the new behaviour in lib/panel-snapshot.js, lib/commands.js and client.js, each restored; and a run in the real DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2 desktop app with the plugin installed from its local directory, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as the reviewer and DSH_AWR_CLI naming the changed awr

checks.name: Nothing the panel asks for shows as JSON or a log line in the conversation
checks.details: The data of the panel is a file the host writes (lib/panel-snapshot.js) and the panel reads through ctx.remote.workspaceFiles, which writes nothing to the conversation; /awr panel answers with one sentence, which is its whole row (test/panel-text.test.js compares the text exactly). A first design that hid the data in an HTML comment after the sentence (#34) showed the comment in the real app, which is why this was redone. A closed panel runs no command (test/client.test.js), and the panel runs /awr panel only when the file is missing or older than 30 s, on Refresh, or when a running takeover's file stops changing. Sixteen mutations of this behaviour (no write after a command, data in the command text, no write queue, a loop that never stops, a path that leaves the directory, a world-readable file, another directory, always asking on opening, the stuck-takeover rule, no staleness check after an action, polling too fast or while closed, an action that asks the host, a wrong Windows separator, no first read for the dot) each fail a test.
criteria: Nothing the panel asks for shows as JSON or a log line in the conversation: its own queries return one readable sentence and keep the data out of sight, and a panel that is closed asks nothing.

checks.name: A takeover with a real model leaves only readable lines in the conversation of the real desktop app
checks.details: In DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2 (desktop) with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as the reviewer: continuing a stopped takeover added one conversation row ('Resumed the takeover of ...'); the whole run (review, accept, organize, receipt, under a minute) added none while the panel followed it step by step from the file; opening the panel on an old file added one row ('AWR 项目 · 0 项进行中，0 项就绪，2 项阻塞') and opening it again at once added none. Limit: the rows of earlier runs with the old plugin versions are still in that conversation.
criteria: This is shown in the real DeepSeek Harness desktop app: a takeover with a real model leaves only readable lines in the conversation.
